classification.difficultyReason: Several linked decisions using the demonstrated definitions or procedures. Page 49 defines union; page 44 explicitly identifies (-infinity,infinity) with all real numbers and illustrates both unbounded directions.

content.prompt:
Simplify the following sets and write the result as a single interval.
$$(-\infty,1]\cup[0,\infty)$$

answer.worked:
The intervals overlap on $[0,1]$. Together they contain every real number.
$$(-\infty,1]\cup[0,\infty)=(-\infty,\infty).$$
